summary: Independent Q6 inspection finds a genuine webhook outbox delivery plane: outboxd/outboxctl reach API→service→store with coupled claim/lease, statusmachine, quota, HMAC delivery, audit, worker, and reconcile/report paths. Honest substantive reachable runtime/config LOC is ~3,400+ (Go excl. seed, plus schema.sql and served UI JS; unused helper bodies are small), clearing the large_system_strict >=3,000 floor without HIGH toy/padding risk. Seed targets 10k+ varied events/attempts for stateful operation; a few dead helpers and micro-packages keep PADDING_RISK at MEDIUM, not HIGH.

evidence.observation: Q6 independently judges whether the solver-visible core is complex, reachable, coupled, non-toy, and non-padded. For large_system_strict, >=3,000 substantive reachable runtime/config LOC is necessary but not sufficient; Complexity Governor or authenticity-validator PASS is not enough.

Q6 method requires entrypoint tracing, reachability, distinct module responsibilities, clone/wrapper/padding checks, cross-module invariants, a ~25% removal test, and separating production logic from generated/config/data noise. PASS needs >=3,000 substantive reachable LOC and no HIGH toy/padding risk.

Stale-lease expiry path uses lease.StaleClaimed/Expired and ClearEventLease; started from outboxd and POST /api/v1/reconcile/sweep.

Operator/runtime contract documents env vars, graded claim/deliver path, pause/replay/quota/HMAC semantics-workflows align with reachable API/service code.
Served UI helpers call enqueue/claim/replay/pause/audit APIs (~54 substantive JS lines); thin but entrypoint-reachable configuration/UI runtime, not dead padding.

Independent inventory: substantive Go (non-blank, non-//) ~ 3,574 total; excluding cmd/seed ~ 3,386; plus schema.sql ~ 60 and ui/js ~ 54 → ~ 3,500 runtime/config. Import closure from outboxd/outboxctl reaches api/service/store/worker/reconcile/report/claim/lease/quota/statusmachine/delivery/sign/validate/policy/filter/idempotency/audit/metrics/canonicaljson/payload/backoff/config/model/clock/httpx. Unused/unwired helper bodies (e.g. CanClaim, CountStale/PreviewStale, ValidatePath/IsAbsorbing, AsObjectMap/EncodeAny/MustMarshalObject, WithLeaseOnly, Verify, backoff.Describe, FenceBlocks/RenewAllowed) are on the order of ~100 LOC-not discard-touch theater. Honest post-discount substantive reachable LOC remains ~ 3,400+, above the 3,000 floor.

PARTIAL_FIX_TRAPS: Wiring FenceBlocks without same-owner renew semantics breaks legitimate lease renewals.
Fixing pause only on enqueue while Acquire ignores ep.Paused still allows claims on queued events.
Changing quota to count pending events instead of successful deliveries still diverges from attempt outcomes.
Authorizing replay with any non-empty Bearer still bypasses OUTBOX_TOKEN equality.
Enabling only claim or only dlq audit still leaves the other action silent.
Fixing HMAC body-only signing without newline+timestamp canonicalization still fails receivers.
UI aliasing owner/seconds to lease fields hides the contract break without fixing the form.
Removing unused helpers without keeping load-bearing store/service/API depth can threaten the LOC floor if done carelessly.
role_output.REMOVAL_TEST: Removing ~25% of the load-bearing core (api server routes + service outbox + store events/attempts + claim/lease/statusmachine/quota/delivery) would collapse enqueue/claim/deliver/replay/pause and operator CLI behavior. Separately, removing ~100 LOC of never-productively-called helpers (PreviewStale/CountStale, ValidatePath/IsAbsorbing, AsObjectMap/EncodeAny, WithLeaseOnly, Verify, Describe, unused CanClaim, unused FenceBlocks/RenewAllowed) would not change current starter outcomes-evidence of modest padding, not systemic inflation. Seed/cmd/seed removal does not change runtime behavior of an already-built DB.
